name: Wild Princess: A Black Dowry Tale
source:
A young woman is sent to marry the enemy of her people. She leaves her homeland in the care of a group of mercenaries.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
一名年轻女子被派去嫁给她人民的敌人。她离开祖国，由一群雇佣兵照顾。

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用程序[/url]]
